questions.question: 1 344 seedlings come in trays of 24. Write a number sentence, solve it and check by substitution.
questions.expected_answer: The number sentence is □ × 24 = 1 344. Divide 1 344 by 24 to get 56 trays. Check: 56 × 24 = 1 344, so the sentence is true.

questions.question: For the pattern 5; 9; 13; 17, give the rule and find the 10th term.
questions.expected_answer: The pattern goes up by 4, so multiply the position by 4 and add 1. The 10th term is 10 × 4 + 1 = 41.

questions.question: 3/8 of 1 344 seedlings are fruit trees and 25% are indigenous trees. How many of each are there?
questions.expected_answer: One eighth of 1 344 is 168, and three eighths is 504 fruit trees. 25% is one quarter, and one quarter of 1 344 is 336 indigenous trees.
